Frequently Asked Questions About Junk Cleanout Services in Whitby, ON

items.q: Q: What do cleanout services cost in Whitby?
a: A: Volume alone sets it — small jobs from $125, garages and basements mid-range, whole homes as one flat multi-load figure at the free walkthrough. Early, evening and weekend scheduling adds nothing, and approved prices are final whatever the space reveals.

items.q: Q: Do I have to be home for the whole cleanout?
a: A: Only for the twenty-minute walkthrough and your approval — after that, presence is optional. Many Whitby clears run while the household is at work: we sort carefully, set aside anything significant, send photo updates on request, and lock up as arranged. You come home to swept, empty space.

items.q: Q: Can you work around commuter hours — early mornings, evenings, weekends?
a: A: It’s the core of how we schedule here. Crews run 6AM to 11PM seven days a week: walkthroughs before the GO train, clears finished by pickup time, Saturday jobs wrapped before the afternoon game. No premium for any of it.

items.q: Q: The basement has been "next weekend's project" for three years. How long does it actually take you?
a: A: Usually a few hours — that’s the anticlimax. A typical Whitby basement or garage clears in one visit; full homes generally finish within a day, trucks cycling as needed. The walkthrough gives you an honest timeline, not a hopeful one.

items.q: Q: Can we split the job across weekends?
a: A: Absolutely, with no penalty — the garage this Saturday, the basement after March break. Volume pricing works identically split or whole, and the quote holds between phases.
